bullets.text: Microsoft's £22 Billion UK Investment - **Microsoft** commits to building the UK's largest supercomputer, surpassing **Google**'s recent investment.
CodeRabbit's $60M Series B - The AI code review startup **CodeRabbit** raises significant funding, valuing it at $550 million.
Apple Music Import Tool Launch - **Apple** expands its music import tool globally, easing transitions from competitors like **Spotify**.
Apple Wallet's New Feature - **Apple**'s Wallet app in iOS 26 now saves full credit card details, enhancing user convenience.
AirPods Pro 3 Exclusive Features - The new **AirPods Pro 3** offer improved features, but some are exclusive to **iPhone 17** users.
Waymo's Airport Service Approved - **Waymo** receives permission to test its robotaxi service at San Francisco International Airport.
Gemini App Dominates Downloads - **Gemini**'s new AI image model, Nano Banana, propels it to the top of app store charts.
Impulse Space's Fast Satellite Delivery - **Impulse** promises same-day satellite delivery, revolutionizing space transport timelines.
Andrew Yang's Noble Mobile Launch - **Andrew Yang** introduces a budget cell carrier that rewards users for lower data usage.
Tesla's Powerwall Recall - **Tesla** recalls Powerwall 2 batteries in Australia due to fire risks, though no injuries reported.
